user.title: Home Climate
user.description:
Copy your private home_climate_bindings.json into Home Assistant’s configuration directory before saving. Edit room profiles, weekly schedules, peak hours and recovery settings below; all settings are validated and saved together. Protection thresholds remain separate from comfort bands. Room cards support Schedule, Temporary and persistent Hold presets. Live permission and Controller enabled are both required for automated comfort.

{detail}

data_description.live: Off previews plans. On activates the heater power guard and permits comfort control when Controller enabled is on.
data_description.normal_heating_floor_f: Heating protection threshold in the qualified normal outdoor regime. Room comfort targets stay separate.
data_description.freezing_heating_floor_f: Heating protection threshold in the qualified freezing outdoor regime; also used conservatively when outdoor conditions are unknown.
data_description.freezing_outdoor_below_f: The outdoor reference for selecting normal, freezing, and boundary regimes.
data_description.emergency_cooling_at_f: A room at or above this temperature requests cooling protection regardless of comfort priority.
data_description.release_hysteresis_f: Temperature recovery required inside the active protection threshold before releasing a protection request.
data_description.transition_deadband_f: The outdoor band used when qualifying regime changes. It does not add a delay to indoor emergency checks.
data_description.qualification_seconds: How long outdoor conditions must persist before a regime change. Indoor protection checks add no qualification delay.
data_description.boundary_tie_mode: Preference for equally severe heating and cooling violations in the qualified boundary regime. Larger measured violations always win.
data_description.unknown_outdoor_tie_mode: Preference for equally severe violations when no valid outdoor reading is available. Larger measured violations always win.
data_description.rooms: Editable room rules in °F. Weekdays use Monday=0 through Sunday=6; overnight periods belong to their starting day. Limits-only profiles enforce their lower and upper bounds without seeking a target. Device bindings remain separate.
data_description.auxiliary_policy: Peak hours and assistance thresholds. These rules apply only during automated Dyson ownership; genuine shutdown faults remain separate.
data_description.seasonal_policy: Averaging window, warm/cool hysteresis thresholds and first-start profile. Local outdoor observations are preferred; source degradation is reported separately from freeze protection.
data_description.fallback: Dual-setpoint heat-pump range and circulation fan speed when active control ends, including restart or fault. Auxiliary heat is stopped unless the Dyson is under explicit manual takeover.
data_description.heartbeat_timeout_seconds: Maximum interval without a confirmed controller health renewal. Independent auxiliary heat authorization has its own shorter deadline.
data_description.auxiliary_heartbeat_timeout_seconds: Maximum interval without a renewed authorization for automated auxiliary heat. This is separate from ordinary command acknowledgement and the controller health heartbeat.

error.invalid_config: The Home Climate configuration could not be validated.

abort.single_instance_allowed: Only one shared-system controller may be configured.
